user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 360 lux 到 490 lux
期望 温度 处于 20 ℃ 到 25 ℃
二氧化碳浓度 应 低于 7%
IF 人不在家 THEN 清洁环境
如果 人在家 那么 提高环境香味
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() < 360 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() > 490 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() < 360 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() > 490 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() > 25 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_cooling_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() < 20 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_heating_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 7 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_air_purifier
